									<div data-id="861ade0" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default"><div><h3>10 ROOMS - 64 SLEEPING POSSIBILITIES</h3></div></div><div data-id="c0184bf" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default"><div><div><ul><li>The hostel has 10 rooms with beds for 4, 8 and 12 people. In total, there are 64 sleeping facilities.</li><li>Each room is inspired by a top surf spot somewhere in the world. So you have the rooms California, Morocco, Hawaii, Tahiti, Mexico, Philippines, Australia, Caribbean, Bali and Costa Rica.</li><li>Each room is decorated according to its own style and atmosphere.</li></ul></div></div></div>								</div>
				</div>
